title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for depression.

HPI
Pt is a 67-year-old male presenting for f/u of major depressive disorder. Pt reports stable mood over the past month. Denies significant changes in sleep or appetite. States he is managing symptoms well with current regimen. No acute concerns reported today.

Medication List
Sertraline 100mg PO QD

Exam
Pt alert and oriented x3. Cooperative and pleasant. Speech is normal rate and volume. Mood is stable. Affect is congruent. Thought process is linear and goal-directed. Insight and judgment are intact.

Assessment
1. Major depressive disorder, recurrent.

Plan
1. Continue current Sertraline dose.
2. Pt to continue monitoring mood and report any changes.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed,
L. Moreau, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, severity not documented (no HCC): F33.9.

distractors.why: No severity is documented: do not assume one.
